description: Skill-authoring and management tools for the Skills Assistant

manage_skill.reason: Creates, edits, deletes, or resets a skill's instructions — reversible, no code execution. Reading and creating new skills is autonomous; editing, deleting, or resetting an existing one asks first.

browse_community_skills.reason: Imports a skill's content from an external source (WordPress.org or Agentic's recommended feed) — browsing what's available is autonomous, importing asks first.

agents_available.reason: Read-only browsing of the community agent catalog.
